antonio.u07: Nils "Brick" Antonio came up with a draft of replacements on Day 11. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Nils "Brick" Antonio helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Across from U-F16, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Nils "Brick" Antonio saw it. Dorian Therealnik was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Nils "Brick" Antonio before dusk. Nils "Brick" Antonio read it twice and slept a little easier.
A clear shot from U-F16. Nils "Brick" Antonio gravely wounded Silas Indinsea and slid back down below the parapet.
Nils "Brick" Antonio taught Marek Profile three words in the language of home. Marek uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.

Nils "Brick" Antonio lent Rafael Hitmanharry a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home reached Nils "Brick" Antonio before dusk. Nils "Brick" Antonio read it twice and slept a little easier.
A man asked Nils "Brick" Antonio to describe Millbank without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
big__chongo: The new rifleman is Gustav Chongo, once a carpenter from Dunmarrow. The corporal asked if a carpenter was any use in a trench. Gustav Chongo said he would find out.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C2 changed before the cheering ended. Gustav Chongo shouldered another load.

The sergeant at S-C2 called out a range and a spot. Gustav Chongo was the only one who hit it. Walter Jacobsoifu was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gustav Chongo answered to number 862. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Gustav Chongo helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Gustav Chongo wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Gustav Chongo has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Gustav Chongo. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.
Old Tom the crow follows Gustav Chongo along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Gustav Chongo was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Severin Ricefarmer was badly wounded.
catshannon1974: Ulrich Catshannon reported to S-R15 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich Catshannon could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ulrich Catshannon accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Catshannon watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Ulrich Catshannon was made Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too.
Ulrich Catshannon woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.
Ulrich Catshannon wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Ulrich Catshannon said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.

A bullet struck Ulrich Catshannon below the ribs at S-R15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Cyril Moodie of the Concord (@peter_moodster__moodie). Ulrich Catshannon held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
A letter came with Konrad "Mud" Catshannon: "I am Ulrich Catshannon's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
champ_is_here_6981: On the way to U-F17, Arno Here tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Arno Here was hit through the stomach at U-F17. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829). Arno Here was killed at U-F17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829).

Gustav Here took the same post at U-F17 where Arno Here stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F17. Gustav Here has learned to walk bent double.
Gustav Here lay behind a dead tree trunk at U-F17 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Dietrich Dbrt was grazed.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Pavel Blokkhead, grazed. Gustav Here cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Gustav Here and Edmund Raptor sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Gustav Here. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Gustav Here aimed a step ahead and fired: Marek Profile, grazed.
geronimoleysen: Otto Geronimoleys came from Varenne, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

A letter reached Otto Geronimoleys from Varenne. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Otto Geronimoleys read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Otto Geronimoleys taught Hugo Luissantos to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home reached Otto Geronimoleys before dusk. Otto Geronimoleys read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dawn watch. Otto Geronimoleys put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Oskar "Mud" Pyyro, badly wounded.

Otto Geronimoleys was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F2, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213). Otto Geronimoleys was killed at R-F2 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
Clement Geronimoleys joined R-F2 under the shadow of Otto Geronimoleys's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A loose thread in Clement Geronimoleys's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

Clement Geronimoleys was on watch at R-F2 when the night raid hit. The men found Clement Geronimoleys at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Clement Geronimoleys helped clear the shelf without saying why.

The men have learned that Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys keeps feeding the rats. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys is number 324. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys went out with the wiring party at N-F11. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys mended the hole in Ivo Echoss's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Ivo says the patch is stronger than the trousers.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F2, then nothing but pain. Raider: Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
htmmci: By the time Tobias Htmmci reached R-S3, the war was 8 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Tobias Htmmci of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek Izu kept the tin.

A bullet clipped Tobias Htmmci's helmet at R-S3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion). Tobias Htmmci saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-S3 and fired once. Cyril Art was grazed. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Tobias Htmmci read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The wound on Tobias Htmmci's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Tobias Htmmci got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 555. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-S3. Tobias Htmmci has learned to walk bent double.
Tobias Htmmci read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Tobias Htmmci held the mirror while Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The whole squad at R-S3 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Tobias Htmmci's bullet that found Benedikt Falloutvam, badly wounded.
Tobias Htmmci traded a child's drawing of a horse for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Someone asked Tobias Htmmci to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
jesh20000: The draft reached R-R17 on Day 9. Gideon Jesh was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Gideon Jesh wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Gideon Jesh fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Jakub "Bones" Imerv was grazed. Gideon Jesh ate breakfast without a word. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gideon Jesh folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Gideon Jesh had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Leopold "Ghost" Alexj crossed it, Gideon Jesh fired. Leopold "Ghost" Alexj was grazed.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Gideon Jesh read a theatre review while peeling supper.

A bullet struck Gideon Jesh below the ribs at R-R17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707). Gideon Jesh was killed on watch at R-R17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707).
A letter came with Marek Jesh: "I am Gideon Jesh's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Marek Jesh was hit in the hip at R-R17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord (@coopergfulton). Marek Jesh looked over the parapet at R-R17 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord (@coopergfulton).
Tobias Jesh joined R-R17 under the shadow of Marek Jesh's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Tobias Jesh carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
major_detroit313: Viktor Detroit arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin of tobacco and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The first hundred were recognised, and Viktor Detroit was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.

The blanket exchange left Viktor Detroit with a better blanket and a reputation for sharp dealing. The previous owner wants a rematch. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Viktor Detroit could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Viktor Detroit put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
Viktor Detroit spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

There is a sniper across the way the men call the Clockmaker. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Clockmaker hit all three. Viktor Detroit watched where the shots came from. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Viktor Detroit looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Viktor Detroit lay in the ruins of Sorrow Copse all day. the Clockmaker did not fire once. Neither did Viktor Detroit. Both of them know.
Viktor Detroit polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Viktor Detroit made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Viktor Detroit fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Wendel "Mole" Freddie was gravely wounded.

At R-F13 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Viktor Detroit turned around and took a shovel blow. Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla). From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Viktor Detroit wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Viktor Detroit came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. After the loss of Grey Mill, Viktor Detroit helped stack spare sandbags at R-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Anselm Erikvukk mended the hole in Viktor Detroit's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Viktor says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
Viktor Detroit lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F13 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Hugo Blasian was gravely wounded.
At dusk a glint from the ridge. Viktor Detroit fired once. The front has been quiet ever since, and nobody talks about the Clockmaker any more.

Viktor Detroit went down at Verdel Ridge and did not get up. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Viktor Detroit was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. Viktor Detroit opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F13 they cheered when the news came up the line.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Viktor Detroit waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. Viktor Detroit was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door.
marshall_n7: On Day 9 Jakub Marshall took a post at R-C13 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He can fall asleep anywhere, instantly, and the men liked him for it.

Jakub Marshall rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Benedikt Ghostrider was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. Jakub Marshall walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Jakub Marshall taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks. The clerk counted the names twice. Jakub Marshall is number 897 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jakub Marshall helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
New laces made Jakub Marshall's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
The corporal found out Jakub Marshall used to be a stonemason. Jakub Marshall has been doing two jobs ever since.
Jakub Marshall ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Jakub Marshall put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.

A round came through the loophole Jakub Marshall was watching at R-C13 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus). Jakub Marshall was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot.
mt_jeff01: Ivo Jeff stepped off the supply cart at T-F16 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ivo Jeff wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Ivo Jeff was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F16 with the rations. Ivo Jeff ate while listening to the revised orders.
Ivo Jeff and Cyril Ssherman carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
The cook borrowed Ivo Jeff's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
A parcel came for Ivo Jeff that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Ivo Jeff was hit in the hip at T-F16. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Konrad Site of the Hegemony (@conors_site). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Ivo Jeff fell at T-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Konrad Site of the Hegemony (@conors_site).
The papers say Emil "Rabbit" Jeff. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Ivo Jeff's eyes. Nobody in T-F16 argues.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Emil "Rabbit" Jeff landed next to Jakub Sandorthehou in the Hegemony trench. Only Emil "Rabbit" Jeff climbed back out. (@sandorthehound) Emil "Rabbit" Jeff crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Casimir Lordfulgrim reached for a rifle. Emil "Rabbit" Jeff was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@lordfulgrim) Emil "Rabbit" Jeff made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Emil "Rabbit" Jeff crawled the last yards.
myrlnmwstkn: Yann Myrlnmwstkn introduced himself as a blacksmith from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Yann Myrlnmwstkn joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Back from the raid, Yann Myrlnmwstkn found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Call Me' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
ohcuri: Nils "Mud" Ohcuri reached T-F4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Nils "Mud" Ohcuri stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Nils "Mud" Ohcuri had just lit a cigarette at T-F4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin). The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Nils "Mud" Ohcuri looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Nils "Mud" Ohcuri was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at T-F4. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
No bed for Nils "Mud" Ohcuri yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Nils "Mud" Ohcuri died waiting. The men at T-F4 have not stopped talking about it.
Viktor "Hollow" Ohcuri put a child's drawing of a horse beside the bunk. Someone who had known Nils "Mud" Ohcuri helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Viktor "Hollow" Ohcuri measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A pump handle snapped off in Viktor "Hollow" Ohcuri's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
r0ttenrivers: Oskar Ttenrivers joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

On sentry duty Oskar Ttenrivers watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back. Grey Mill has been won. Oskar Ttenrivers listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Oskar Ttenrivers took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Oskar Ttenrivers was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
The list for Oskar Ttenrivers's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Oskar Ttenrivers held the gathering in a shelter after supper. The poem was read badly, the song went better, and nobody interrupted the silence.

Oskar Ttenrivers was on the dawn watch at T-F18 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Oskar Ttenrivers was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ulrich Son of the Concord (@straight_dogma_son).
sergiootd: The old hands of R-R8 have been here since Day 1. Henrik Sergiootd has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Henrik Sergiootd reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The flare went up just as Henrik Sergiootd reached the Concord parapet. Henrik Sergiootd jumped down first. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt was the man waiting there, and Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt fell. (@knightowlvt) Victory at Blackwater Canal. Henrik Sergiootd let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dawn watch. Henrik Sergiootd put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Karel Bachini, grazed. A clear shot from R-R8. Henrik Sergiootd gravely wounded Lucien Hill and slid back down below the parapet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Henrik Sergiootd walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Henrik Sergiootd borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Sergiootd fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Sergiootd spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F5 is closed now. Henrik Sergiootd let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Tobias Guy was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Sergiootd tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik Sergiootd. Henrik Sergiootd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Henrik Sergiootd went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Concord trench a man turned around too late. Felix Topekeno did not get up again. (@topekeno) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Henrik Sergiootd dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Dietrich Jackson coming out. It was over in seconds. (@george_jackson2004) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Henrik Sergiootd snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Henrik Sergiootd free. There was no bed for Henrik Sergiootd. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Henrik Sergiootd, and the soup went cold while Henrik Sergiootd read it.
spencercensor: Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso stepped off the supply cart at T-F3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso was faster. Marek "Saint" Luxos was grazed. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. A letter from home reached Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso before dusk. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso read it twice and slept a little easier.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso fired, and Clement William was grazed.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at T-F3 is up. The gun crews at T-F3 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Marek "Saint" Luxos was grazed.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso aimed a step ahead and fired: Marek "Saint" Luxos, badly wounded.
A supply man offered Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
tf141simon_riley_ghost: Otto "Shadow" Ghost joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Otto "Shadow" Ghost fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Walter "Spark" Cthulhu, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at P-F8 changed before the cheering ended. Otto "Shadow" Ghost shouldered another load.
Otto "Shadow" Ghost fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Felix Able, now gravely wounded.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Otto "Shadow" Ghost closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Otto "Shadow" Ghost fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Jakub "Bones" Travel was grazed.
Karel Ali and Otto "Shadow" Ghost argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Otto "Shadow" Ghost owes Valentin Halfire so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
w_corp_public_relations: The quartermaster asked Jakub Relations to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
At the Hanging Bridge, Jakub Relations of the Hegemony and Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S3 changed before the cheering ended. Jakub Relations shouldered another load.

Jakub Relations studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-S3 in the dark to learn it by heart. The clerk counted the names twice. Jakub Relations is number 557 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Jakub Relations shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Jakub Relations across the shin at S-S3. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr of the Concord (@tylermontygrisco).
The medic looked at Jakub Relations's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Jakub Relations checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Jakub Relations censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jakub Relations in the open at S-S3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Roland Maccerny of the Concord (@maccerny808). The bearers reached Jakub Relations at S-S3 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Roland Maccerny of the Concord (@maccerny808).
Clement Relations asked about Jakub Relations on arriving at S-S3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
wpjarrell07: Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell arrived at N-F3 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell taught Emil "Saint" Akr three words in the language of home. Saint uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell taught Emil "Saint" Akr to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Albin Tiiiir, grazed. Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Gideon Jetsonxwrigh was grazed.
